provenance: Second pass on the tone-marking register: faces and gestures whose conventional online reading has drifted from their CLDR name, beyond the core set in 02-irony-tone.json.

😃.gloss: The wide-open smile reads as slightly manic next to the softer 😊, so it is often used for forced cheer.

😁.gloss: The visible clenched teeth push this towards strain rather than delight.

🤗.gloss: Frequently read as insincere or patronising, which is why sincere comfort has migrated to 🫂.

😉.gloss: Now reads as slightly seedy or generationally marked; 😏 has taken its place.

😜.gloss: Belongs to an earlier era of internet register; using it now reads as either ironic or out of touch.

🤭.gloss: Pretending to have said something one shouldn't, while fully intending to.

😒.gloss: Harsher in text than the face suggests; often ends a conversation.

😠.gloss: Genuine anger is more often conveyed by flat text or 🙂; the angry face has become theatrical.

😡.gloss: The intensified form is even more clearly a performance.

🤬.gloss: Stands in for profanity, letting the writer swear without typing it.

😱.gloss: The Home Alone face, used for exaggerated surprise at trivia.

🥶.gloss: Praise for something ruthless, alongside the literal 'I'm freezing'.

🤔.gloss: Rarely genuine thought; usually implies the reader should draw an unflattering conclusion.

🧐.gloss: The monocle performs examination rather than doing any.

😮.gloss: Often a reaction that signals nothing more than 'seen'.

🫢.gloss: Genuine or performed shock at something scandalous.

🫣.gloss: Peeking through fingers at an unfolding disaster, frequently one's own.

🙅.gloss: Read as sassy dismissal rather than a neutral 'no'.

💁.gloss: The tossed-hair pose conveys 'obviously' or 'not my problem'.

🤦.gloss: Directed at others or at oneself; one of the least ambiguous glyphs in the set.

🙆.gloss: Arms crossed overhead means 'correct' in Japan; outside it, the pose is often misread as celebration.

🫥.gloss: Signalling withdrawal from a conversation rather than an inability to participate.

😵.sense: overwhelmed to the point of shutdown
😵.gloss: Read as burnout rather than injury.

🤯.gloss: So overused in marketing copy that sincere use now needs support from context.

🥳.gloss: Frequently the emoji of a birthday message someone was reminded to send.

😬.gloss: Sent after a message the writer suspects will land badly.

🫤.gloss: The softest available way to signal 'I don't think so'.

🤥.gloss: Pinocchio's nose; competes with 🧢 and is losing.

😗.gloss: Feigning innocence about something just mentioned.

🤷‍♀️.gloss: The gendered variants carry slightly different registers in practice, the feminine reading as more pointedly unbothered.

💁‍♂️.gloss: The masculine variant is often used for deliberately camp effect.

🫸.gloss: The pushing hand, added in Emoji 15.0, was adopted quickly for 'absolutely not'.

🫷.gloss: The mirror-image hand, used in the same register.
